description: The bar chart illustrates model accuracy percentages across three benchmark categories for multiple reinforcement-learning-style methods. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 62 with tick marks at 2-point intervals. Each category shows a grouped set of six bars corresponding to the legend entries: DAPO (light blue with diagonal hatching), DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal hatching), PPO (teal with diagonal hatching), and an additional solid green method (label shown as a green swatch in the legend). For Mathverse, the bars are approximately DAPO 53.1, DAPO+Self-reflection 56.1, SRPO 55.8, GRPO 53.4, PPO 53.3, and green 54.5. For MMLU, the grouped bars are approximately DAPO 55.9, DAPO+Self-reflection 56.9, SRPO 57.1, GRPO 55.8, PPO 54.6, and green 56.2. For Physics, the bars are approximately DAPO 57.5, DAPO+Self-reflection 61.0, SRPO 60.6, GRPO 58.1, PPO 56.9, and green 59.1. The bars are not sorted by height within each group, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the use of distinct colors and hatching patterns to differentiate methods.
